Requirement: Staff must be able to create an order linked to a specific table and add menu items to that order.
Source: Focus Group — FOH; Stakeholder — Shane Breslin

Requirement: Staff must be able to mark an order as completed. This action must be blocked if the required number of allergen consents have not been recorded.
Source: Focus Group — All roles; Stakeholder — Damian

Requirement: Authorised staff (manager / owner / admin) must be able to void an active order. Every void must be recorded with a timestamp.
The system must track course progression status per order (Not Started / Starters Served / Mains Served / Desserts Served).
The system must calculate an order total cost and apply a discount to produce a final price.
Staff must be able to view a real-time list of all tables showing current status: Available / Occupied / Reserved.
Source: Focus Group — FOH; Stakeholder — FOH Staff; Stakeholder — Shane Breslin

Requirement: Staff must be able to seat walk-in customers at an available table without requiring a prior booking.
Staff must be able to set the number of customers currently seated at a table.
Management must be able to add / edit / deactivate tables. A table must not be deletable while it has active orders.
Any user (including anonymous users) must be able to create a booking via a public form.
The booking form must capture a self-declared allergen flag (HasAllergen). If ticked the system must surface an allergen warning at the point of seating.
Source: Focus Group — All roles; Stakeholder — Damian; Stakeholder — FOH Staff

Requirement: Staff must be able to transition a booking from Booked to Seated. This action must mark the linked table as occupied and trigger an allergen check.
Source: Stakeholder — FOH Staff; Stakeholder — Shane Breslin

Requirement: Staff must be able to edit and cancel bookings. Cancelled bookings must be moved to a separate completed/cancelled view.
Staff must be able to record a formal allergen consent against an active order. The record must capture customer name / email / phone / the specific menu items covered / and a ConsentGiven flag.
Source: Focus Group — All roles; Stakeholder — Shane Breslin

Requirement: The system must enforce that the number of allergen consents recorded against an order meets the required count before MarkCompleted is permitted.
Allergen consents must be viewable in a list and individually by order.
Management must be able to create / edit / deactivate and delete menus. An active menu must not be deletable.
Management must be able to add and remove menu items within a menu. Each item must support name / price / type / description / photo URL.
Management must be able to create and edit ingredients. Each ingredient must carry an allergen flag and an allergen information description.
Ingredients must be linkable to menu items. The allergen status of linked ingredients must be visible on the menu item detail view.
Admin and owner roles must be able to create / edit and delete user accounts and assign roles.
Users must not be able to self-assign a privileged role at registration. New registrations must default to the guest role.
Source: Security — OWASP A01 Broken Access Control

Requirement: A user must not be able to change their own role.
Authenticated users must be able to submit a star rating (1–5) and comment against a completed order.
Staff and management must be able to view all submitted reviews.

The booking form must validate: customer name (minimum 3 characters), email format (requires TLD), phone number (Irish/UK format), booking date/time (must not be in the past), guest count (must not exceed table capacity).

A new staff member must be able to complete all common tasks (create booking / create order / record allergen consent) after a single shift of onboarding. The interface must be consistent across all functional areas.
Source: Focus Group — All roles; Stakeholder — Shane Breslin

Requirement: Common tasks must be completable in the minimum number of steps. No common task should require navigation through more than two pages.
Role-based navigation must show only the functions relevant to the logged-in user's role. Functions outside a role's permissions must not be visible in the navigation bar.
Search and filter operations (menu item search / table list refresh) must update without a full page reload to minimise disruption during live service.
All management and staff routes must be protected by role-based authorisation. Unauthenticated requests to protected routes must be redirected to the login page.
Source: Security — OWASP A01 Broken Access Control

Requirement: All allergen consent records must be persisted to the database and must not be deletable without management authorisation. The audit trail must be intact for the lifetime of the associated order.
The system must support configurable data retention policies for consent records to allow compliance with applicable data protection requirements.
The system must present a consistent CRUD interface across all entities so that a user who learns one area (e.g. Menu) can navigate any other area (e.g. Bookings) without additional training.
